newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums touch easier, despite swaps buyin.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums touch easier, despite swaps buyin.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums to gas oil futures were a touch weaker on Wednesday, despite heavy swaps buying.
Weaker IPE gas oil further weakened outright prices.
Traders said physical spot buying remained very slack with premiums $1-2 lower for cargoes around March IPE gas oil +$27/28 cif NWE but holding for barges at March IPE gas oil +$26 fob.
Airlines have been busy acquiring more than a million tonnes of jet on the paper market over the last couple of weeks in a bout of buying unparalleled since before the Gulf War seven years ago.
"Over the last couple of weeks we've seen a million tonnes hedged on a wide range of paper contracts," said Paul Ford, head of financing products at the Royal Bank of Scotland.
